summary: Shazeer expects rapid AI progress and large gains in health and wealth, and says more care is needed as systems grow more powerful.

statements.quote: It turns out the best way to solve hard problems is still to think about them.
I think we’re going to see orders of magnitude of improvements in GDP, health, wealth, and anything else you can think of.
As these systems do get more powerful, you have to be more and more careful.
